svg.title: Security & Engineering Stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python, C++, Java, Bash, JavaScript; Analysis Infrastructure: Clang / LLVM, CodeQL, Clang AST, Static Analysis, Data Flow, Taint Analysis; Security Environment: Linux, Kali Linux, Docker, Git, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Frida, mitmproxy, Nmap; Agent & Evaluation Research: LLM Agents, Prompt Injection, Security Evaluation, Reproducible Experiments.
